title: Routing & Auth weekly sync: fallbacks roundtable
content:
Meeting: Routing & Auth fallbacks roundtable
Date: 2026-07-12 10:00-10:45 PT
Attendees: Maya, Omar, Priya, Noah, Elena, (notes by Maya)
Purpose: reconcile fallback behaviors across routing, auth, and quota subsystems; produce a short action list for this sprint.

1) Quick status / context (5m)
- Omar: Observed two customer-impact incidents last week where Dedicated pools exhausted and callers got 503s; routing fallback didn't pick compatible hosted variants because of model-tag mismatch.
- Priya: Quota service accelerated throttles for a few mid-tier tenants after quota burst policy change; auth service returned 429 + Retry-After headers but routing did not honor Retry-After semantics.
- Noah: Sampling metrics show increased cold-kv misses when routing fails over to hosted variants (cache warmup penalty).

2) Incident recap (10m)
- Timeline: 2026-07-07 21:10 UTC - dedicated pool exhausted; 21:12 first fallback attempt; 21:12-21:20 elevated latencies; 21:22 spike of failed requests from mobile clients.
- Root cause hypothesis: strict model_variant matching + asymmetry in quota semantics between dedicated and hosted backend caused routing to reject viable fallbacks.
- Impact: two customers saw degraded tail latency (p99 increased ~450ms) and ~0.6% higher error rate for 12 minutes.

3) Agreement on policy changes (10m)
- Allow model_semantic-compatible fallbacks: routing will accept variants flagged as "semantic-compatible" even if exact model_id differs. Implementation: expand model catalog metadata with "semantic-compatible-with" tags. (Owner: Omar, ETA: 2026-07-19)
- Honor auth Retry-After: routing layer will respect 429 Retry-After headers from quota/auth proxies and schedule exponential backoff when appropriate, instead of immediate failover. (Owner: Priya, ETA: 2026-07-16)
- Soft-prefetch warmup for KV cache: when planned failover is triggered, routing will send a warmup probe to best-fit variant to pre-populate KV cache (lightweight token-limited probe). (Owner: Noah, ETA: 2026-07-26; prototype for canary on staging by 2026-07-20)

4) Metrics snapshot (from 07-12 morning)
- p50 latency (control plane routing decision): 8ms
- p95 latency: 22ms
- p99 latency: 65ms (up from 58 last week)
- Dedicated pool eviction rate (last 24h): 0.3% of requests attempted failover
- Cache cold-miss ratio for hosted fallbacks: 42% (goal < 20%)

5) Implementation notes / design decisions (8m)
- Model-tagging: add a lightweight protobuf extension in model-catalog to list semantic_aliases; migration will be incremental. Backward compatible: absent tags => exact-match only.
- Retry semantics between subsystems: standardize on RFC-compliant Retry-After header at gateway edges; add a small routing policy table with per-tenant backoff strategy (default = 1s exponential, max 8s).
- Safety: Do not automatically reroute high-risk customers without opt-in for soft-fallbacks in Dedicated contracts. Admin toggle in Console required.

6) Canaries and testing plan (5m)
- Stage canary: enable semantic-compatible fallbacks for 5 internal tenants for 48h, observe error rate and cold-miss ratio. (Canary target date: 2026-07-20)
- Load testing: synthetic traffic with mixed sequence lengths to validate KV warmup probe effectiveness. (Owner: Elena + SRE, ETA: 2026-07-22)

7) Action items (summary)
- Omar: implement model-catalog semantic_alias field + docs; wire into routing selection (PR + design doc). Due 2026-07-19.
- Priya: add Retry-After awareness in quota/auth proxy + unit tests; update auth SDK docs for semantics. Due 2026-07-16.
- Noah: prototype light warmup probe and measurement harness on staging; include telemetry events for warmup success/failure. Due 2026-07-20 for initial prototype, 2026-07-26 for full implementation.
- Elena: schedule synthetic load run and coordinate with SRE for resource allocation. Due 2026-07-22.
- Maya: update runbook for fallback incidents to include new checklist and postmortem skeleton. Due 2026-07-15.

8) Open questions / unresolved
- How do we price or meter synthetic warmup probes for billing accuracy? (Finance/MD needed)
- For customers with strict data residency & dedicated pools, do we maintain a "no-auto-fallback" default? Legal and CS need to confirm policy language.

9) Quick retro on meeting flow (2m)
- Good: focused scope, clear owners and dates.
- Improve: attach micro-design sketches to agenda next time to shorten implementation debate.

Notes captured by Maya Chen.
Next sync: 2026-07-19 10:00 PT (follow-up on Priya and Omar items; staging canary status).

Appendix (links / quick commands)
- Check current model tags: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/models?fields=id,tags
- Queue probe event: tooling/warmup-probe --model <model-id> --tokens 64 --priority low
- Postmortem template: https://confluence.redwood.internal/infra/postmortems/template

End of notes
